title: FlashSVD v1.5: Making Low-Rank Transformers Inference Actually Fast
selection_reason: FlashSVD v1.5 is a unified inference runtime for SVD-compressed transformers combining phase-specific kernels, dense-KV decode, packed MLP execution and per-layer CUDA-graph replay, achieving up to 2.55x decode and 2.39x end-to-end speedup.
